bindings.name: SUPABASE_AUTH_URL
bindings.requirement: HTTPS only in deployed Worker; no userinfo or embedded credentials

bindings.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
bindings.requirement: public key only; never service_role or secret API key

bindings.name: APPROVAL_ATTESTATION_KEY
bindings.requirement: non-exportable Worker secret; rotation and revocation tested in hosted staging

bindings.name: APPROVAL_HYPERDRIVE
bindings.requirement: restricted alp_approval_worker_login; validated TLS and managed credential rotation

requiredEvidence.description: Dedicated staging and production targets, IAM permissions, and named responsible approver
Independent hosted Hyperdrive connection, encrypted transport and certificate trust verified
Remote passwordless-by-default login provisioned through restricted approved process
Authorized secret binding lifecycle, emergency revoke, and no secrets in source or CI logs
Hosted staging auth origin, session lock and signed approval verified end-to-end
Worker logs and traces enabled in target config with sensitive fields redacted
Canary, rollback, and fail-closed outage rehearsal in staging
Independent managed Supabase full restore/PITR evidence, measured RTO and RPO
Independent security review and written separate release authorization

sourceOnlyEvidence.scope: Local workerd and disposable Supabase, not hosted-cloud readiness

notes: R8 is a release evidence contract, not a deployment configuration. Do not create deployment manifests, secrets or hosted resources until separately approved.
